name: Assamese handwritten compound characters dataset
description: An image dataset for recognition of unconstrained isolated Assamese handwritten compound characters used to evaluate handwriting/character recognition models.
reputation: A specialised dataset for Assamese OCR research with limited but growing recognition in handwriting/region-specific document analysis communities.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark (image-based); may have class imbalance and limited dataset size for some rare compound characters; language/script-specific so not broadly representative; potential for dataset saturation is low given niche scope.
